notes.title: Vistascapes VR update: Massive performance improvements, remastered scenes, birds, and more!
notes.content:
Update 1.1

- Serious performance improvements for all scenes! (especially for Rain Room and Fireworks)

- Updated visuals to all scenes!

- Removed screeching sound from Main Menu scene.

- Added new visuals/sounds to main menu room 

- Increased size of forest scene by x50

- Remastered Rain room and mountain scene

- Birds in mountain scene.

tags.bug: - Removed screeching sound from Main Menu scene.

tags.feature: - Added new visuals/sounds to main menu room

tags.balance_change: - Increased size of forest scene by x50
